title: The bird on the rings
logline: The dock a week after the sequence's rings: the two pale rings on the planks where the cans stood, and the bird standing in one of them. The page lets the sequences touch, once.

panels.composition: Close on dock planks with two pale rings where cans stood, the small rainbow bird standing inside one ring, the water beyond the dock's edge.
